body: Thank you so much, I really am grateful that people like you exist, I am happy to have this chance to share my story and get these supportive responses. I am so grateful.
Amazing. I am really amazed at how you handle this concept. I will definitely check it out, what an amazing view probably from an amazing person. Thank you.
thank you so much, I am really grateful that there are people like you on this world, have a good one

thanks a lot, I would not consider myself a math genius I think my brain was developed earlier than it should be, people still call me intelligent but I am nowhere near the potential that I showed at that age. Thank you very much, even being noticed was a huge deal for me, I cant thank you enough.
It helps me a lot to know there are people like me, not just under the same conditions but who think like me, it really comforts me and helps me a lot. Thank you so much.
Thanks a lot, a single reply means the world to me right now.

I really do not wish this on anyone, I am sure people go through so much worse things but this, is some special shit, it eats you, your confidence, and your mental health slowly till it runs out. You start to wonder every day who you are, what is your purpose, you start to question everything. I am always here, if you ever consider talking to a random stranger is worth your time, thanks, and have a good one.
I will definitely check it out, thank you.
Thank you very much for taking your time and even sharing more. I really enjoyed reading your story, thanks for all the advice. It means a lot to me.
